description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Pond-cell polygons identify facility components, component depth and potential flood-hazard attributes for public and private stormwater ponds. The native layer exposes polygon geometry and named attributes, including AssetID, FacilityID, ComponentType, ComponentDepth, Description, Comment. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for network flow studies. These are pond-cell components, distinct from the existing private-pond inventory; capacity units and full hydraulic connectivity are not established. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. Related existing records below provide broader network or asset-location context; their scope is distinct from this resource.
